description: This source file contains test cases for a Vite project template, utilizing pytest fixtures and test functions to verify project initialization, configuration, and post-processing behaviors.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration data for a project, including name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported project types, including VITE.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Contains information needed for initializing a template, such as commands and environment settings.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Handles the process of initializing a project based on templates and configurations.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides templates given a directory path.

classes.name: ViteTemplate
classes.description: Represents the Vite project template, providing methods to retrieve initialization info and process templates.

methods.name: test_vite_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that the Vite template correctly provides initialization information such as environment commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests whether the project is correctly initialized, including directory structure and content replacements.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures that post-processing scripts are executed and their effects are verifiable.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks loading of project configuration data from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Validates that template variables are correctly substituted in output files.
